adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff replaces `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` plus explicit zod-error logging with `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. The new helper (`packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) throws a generic `Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` on schema mismatch and provides no diagnostic context, whereas the previous code logged `tokenResponse.error` and the raw `responseJson`. This is a diff-grounded regression in observability/debuggability rather than a clear functional defect (errors would still surface before, just with logs).
